name: Sophia Chitlik

items.why: FERC's April 2026 penalty order is a finding against her husband's company (American Efficient), no source I read alleges any conduct by Chitlik, and this is guilt by association rather than her own conduct under criterion 6.

for_review: I couldn't find any statement from Chitlik about the FERC order. I read FERC's press release and the Business NC and INDY/Inside Climate News coverage, and none of them alleges conduct by her. I couldn't open FERC's executive summary, so the fuller order wasn't read. Checking her Statement of Economic Interest for any ownership stake in Modern Energy or American Efficient, and any income from them, would settle whether she has a personal financial link. If she does, a self-dealing or conflict-of-interest question would need to be reconsidered. Reporting from The Assembly and INDY in mid-2026 says Chitlik and Abram are legally separated, citing the News & Observer. American Efficient denies wrongdoing, is appealing, and filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy. The search for her name on the owner's listed sites (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) found nothing relevant to her.
